SHIPPED: Tray menu overhauled in commit 899c744 (+77/-5 lines)

NEW STRUCTURE:
```
Whisnap              ← disabled header, no version
─────────────
Transcribe
History
Settings
─────────────
Send Feedback…       ← opens app + feedback modal
─────────────
Quit Whisnap
```

TECHNICAL PATTERN:
- Rust side: new `open_feedback` menu item emits `open-feedback` Tauri event + shows/focuses window
- Frontend (App.tsx): listens for `open-feedback` event → dispatches `openFeedbackModal` custom event → existing FeedbackModal opens
- The FeedbackModal was already implemented and triggered via custom event — tray just plugs into it

DECISIONS:
- No version number in header (pointless)
- No keyboard shortcuts on menu items (tray menu, where would you press them)
- 'Send Feedback…' uses ellipsis (macOS convention for actions that open a dialog)
